docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

name: codeclimate-test-reporter
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: codeclimate-test-reporter
  version: "0.2.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/codeclimate-test-reporter-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d4a5962323e0ebf7d0e9959bcb605910dbb937ff93b21035421b7967dc242865

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - codeclimate-test-reporter=codeclimate_test_reporter.__main__:run

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - coverage >=4.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - requests

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - codeclimate_test_reporter
        - codeclimate_test_reporter.components
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - codeclimate-test-reporter --help

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Uploads Python test coverage data to Code Climate
  description: |
    These configuration instructions refer to a language-specific test
    reporter which is now deprecated in favor of our new unified test
    reporter client. The new test reporter is faster, distributed as a
    static binary, has support for parallelized CI builds, and will
    receive ongoing support by the team here. The existing test reporters
    for Ruby, Python, PHP, and Javascript are now deprecated.
  homepage: http://github.com/codeclimate/python-test-reporter
  repository: http://github.com/codeclimate/python-test-reporter
  documentation: http://github.com/codeclimate/python-test-reporter

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
